description:
The display name and cost-attribution tags of an organization member who owns API keys.

The document's id is the value API keys carry in `user_id`. The gateway reads the name only to label telemetry, as the `user_name` metric label, where it takes precedence over the key's own `user_name`, and the tags only to attribute requests and to match `tag:` rate-limit policy dimensions; it never uses either for authentication or routing.

name.description: Display name of the member. An empty name is reported as `unknown`.

tags.description: Cost-attribution tags of this member, as tag key to tag value. Each request made with an API key whose `user_id` names this member is attributed to them, per tag key, unless the key itself or the key's team sets the same key. Keys match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$`, values are 1 to 128 characters, and at most 32 entries are allowed. Omitted or empty means the member adds no tags.

title: User
